from pathlib import Path

def review_path(root: Path, commit_range: str, model: str) -> Path:
    # parse commit_range: assume format "start..end"
    start, end = commit_range.split("..")
    model_slug = model.replace("/", "-")
    path = root / "docs" / "reviews" / f"{start}..{end}-{model_slug}.md"
    return path

def refuse_if_exists(path: Path) -> None:
    if path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(str(path))
